verdict.rationale: Atlas documents forming Delaware C corps and LLCs online in about two business days. It provides incorporation documents in the Dashboard, built from Cooley-developed templates, and also issues founder equity, files 83(b) elections, and obtains the EIN. Community users report smooth hands-on incorporations, though one notes that state and city-level legwork remains the founder's job. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that bylaws and initial board approvals/consents are generated and executed, and independent corroboration of those specific governance documents.
